name: Fukushuu
source:
You are a high school student and were embarrassed in front of the class by 4 girls TWICE, each time it was involved with another girl. Now you decide it's time for getting your revenge and you have to choose a partner for additional help..

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=462&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你是一名高中生，曾两次被四名女生当着全班的面羞辱，而且每次都牵涉到另一名女生。如今，你决定展开复仇，还必须选择一名搭档提供额外协助……

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=462&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
